description.en: Four questions per level, starting at A1. The test stops as soon as a level is too hard, so most learners answer far fewer than the full set.
description.ar: أربعة أسئلة لكل مستوى، تبدأ من A1. يتوقف الاختبار فور بلوغك مستوى أصعب مما تتقنه، فيجيب معظم المتعلمين عن عدد أقل بكثير من الأسئلة.

questions.sentence: My name ___ Youssef.

explanation.en: “My name” is singular → is.
explanation.ar: «My name» مفرد فيأخذ is.

questions.sentence: She ___ to work by bus every day.

explanation.en: Present simple with she → goes.
explanation.ar: المضارع البسيط مع she يأخذ goes.

questions.sentence: There ___ four people in my family.

explanation.en: Plural → there are.
explanation.ar: الجمع يأخذ there are.

questions.sentence: I ___ like coffee in the evening.

explanation.en: Negative with I → don't.
explanation.ar: النفي مع I يكون بـ don't.

questions.sentence: I have two ___ at school.

explanation.en: “Child” has the irregular plural “children”.
explanation.ar: جمع child غير قياسي وهو children.

questions.sentence: The meeting is ___ Monday morning.

explanation.en: Days take “on”, even with a part of the day attached.
explanation.ar: أيام الأسبوع تأخذ on حتى مع إضافة جزء من اليوم.

questions.sentence: We ___ to Istanbul last summer.

explanation.en: A finished past time → past simple “went”.
explanation.ar: زمن ماضٍ منتهٍ، فنستخدم الماضي البسيط went.

questions.sentence: This bag is ___ than the other one.

explanation.en: Long adjectives use “more”.
explanation.ar: الصفات الطويلة تأخذ more.

questions.sentence: You ___ smoke here — it's a hospital.

explanation.en: A prohibition → mustn't.
explanation.ar: المنع يُعبَّر عنه بـ mustn't.

questions.sentence: I'm ___ my glasses. Have you seen them?

explanation.en: look for = search for.
explanation.ar: look for تعني البحث عن.

questions.sentence: Be quiet — the baby ___ right now.

explanation.en: Something happening at this moment → present continuous.
explanation.ar: الحدث الجاري الآن يأخذ المضارع المستمر.

questions.sentence: There isn't ___ milk left in the fridge.

explanation.en: “Milk” is uncountable, and negatives take “much”.
explanation.ar: milk اسم غير معدود، والنفي يأخذ much.

questions.sentence: I ___ here since 2020.

explanation.en: “Since” with a period continuing to now → present perfect.
explanation.ar: since مع فترة ممتدة إلى الآن تتطلب المضارع التام.

questions.sentence: If it ___ tomorrow, the match will be cancelled.

explanation.en: First conditional: present simple after “if”.
explanation.ar: الشرط الأول: المضارع البسيط بعد if.

prompt.en: “I am busy,” she said. Which report is correct?

explanation.en: Present → past after a past reporting verb.
explanation.ar: المضارع يتحول إلى ماضٍ بعد فعل نقل ماضٍ.

explanation.en: A finished past time cannot take the present perfect.
explanation.ar: الزمن الماضي المنتهي لا يجتمع مع المضارع التام.

questions.sentence: The man ___ car was stolen called the police.

explanation.en: The car belongs to the man → possessive relative “whose”.
explanation.ar: السيارة ملك للرجل، فنستخدم whose للملكية.

questions.sentence: I'm not used to ___ this early.

explanation.en: “Used to” as an adjective is followed by -ing, not the bare verb.
explanation.ar: be used to يليها الفعل بصيغة -ing لا المصدر.

questions.sentence: ___ the delay, the team met the deadline.

explanation.en: “Despite” + noun phrase; “although” would need a clause.
explanation.ar: despite يليها اسم، وalthough يليها جملة.

questions.sentence: The new policy ___ next month.

explanation.en: The policy receives the action → future passive.
explanation.ar: السياسة متلقية للفعل، فنستخدم المبني للمجهول في المستقبل.

questions.sentence: If we ___ the earlier flight, we ___ the meeting.

explanation.en: Third conditional: an unreal past condition and an unreal past result.
explanation.ar: الشرط الثالث: شرط ونتيجة غير واقعيين في الماضي.

prompt.en: Which sentence is appropriate in a formal email to a client?
prompt.ar: أي جملة تناسب بريداً رسمياً لعميل؟

options: We apologise for the delay and will confirm a new date shortly.
Sorry, things got messed up on our side but we'll fix it soon.
The delay is not really our problem, so please contact the courier.
Hey, sorry about that, will fix it soon and let you know, ok?

explanation.en: Formal, specific and accountable.
explanation.ar: رسمية ومحددة وتتحمّل المسؤولية.

questions.sentence: She suggested ___ the meeting until Friday.

explanation.en: “Suggest” takes -ing, never “suggest to do”.
explanation.ar: الفعل suggest يليه -ing ولا يقال suggest to do.

questions.sentence: No sooner ___ the door than the phone rang.

explanation.en: A negative adverbial at the front forces inversion: auxiliary before subject.
explanation.ar: الظرف المنفي في أول الجملة يوجب القلب: الفعل المساعد قبل الفاعل.

questions.sentence: The committee will ___ a decision at its next meeting.

explanation.en: “Make a decision” is the standard collocation.
explanation.ar: make a decision هو التلازم القياسي.

prompt.en: “The report claims that costs have fallen.” What does “claims” imply?

options: The writer is not endorsing the statement.
The statement is certainly true and verified.
The report is official and government-approved.
The costs are rising rather than falling.

explanation.en: “Claim” signals distance from the assertion.
explanation.ar: claim تُظهر تحفّظ الكاتب عن تبنّي الكلام.

prompt.en: Which sentence is best in an academic paper?

options: The data suggest that the effect may be smaller than previously assumed.
The data prove that everyone else in the field was simply wrong.
Obviously the effect is tiny and nobody should be surprised.
The data show 100% that the effect is small and unimportant.

explanation.en: Hedged claims match the strength of the evidence.
explanation.ar: الصياغة المتحفظة تناسب قوة الدليل.

prompt.en: Which sentence contains an unnatural collocation?
prompt.ar: أي جملة فيها اقتران غير طبيعي؟

options: He did a strong contribution to the debate.
He made a valuable contribution to the debate.
She raised an important objection to the plan.
They drew a firm conclusion from the evidence.

explanation.en: We “make” a contribution, not “do” one.
explanation.ar: نقول make a contribution لا do a contribution.

prompt.en: “The scheme is unlikely to have had much effect.” Which restatement keeps the same strength?
prompt.ar: أي إعادة صياغة تحافظ على القوة نفسها؟

options: It definitely had no effect at all.
It certainly had a very large effect.
It may well have had a large effect.

explanation.en: “Unlikely” is a hedge, so the restatement must stay hedged too.
explanation.ar: unlikely تعبير متحفظ، فيجب أن تبقى إعادة الصياغة متحفظة.

questions.sentence: The auditors ___ serious doubts about the timetable.

explanation.en: Doubts are “raised”; “made a doubt” is not English.
explanation.ar: الشكوك تُثار raise doubts ولا يقال make a doubt.

options: I'd rather not, if that's all right.
I prefer to not do it, if this is all right.
It is preferred by me not to do it.
I have not the wish of doing it.

explanation.en: All are grammatical; only the first is idiomatic.
explanation.ar: الجمل كلها صحيحة نحوياً، لكن الأولى وحدها هي المستعملة فعلاً.

prompt.en: A manager says: “That's certainly one way of doing it.” What is implied?

explanation.en: Faint praise signalling disagreement without confrontation.
explanation.ar: مدح فاتر يحمل اعتراضاً دون مواجهة.

options: The ball is in your field.

explanation.en: The fixed form is “the ball is in your court”.
explanation.ar: الصيغة الثابتة هي the ball is in your court.

prompt.en: Which opening best prepares a reader for an objection?

options: There is much to admire here. That said, …
This is great and well argued. Moreover, …
I read it carefully last night. Therefore, …
It is fine and clearly written. Similarly, …

explanation.en: Concede, then pivot with “that said”.
explanation.ar: أقرّ أولاً ثم انعطف بـ that said.

prompt.en: A reviewer writes: “The author is to be commended for her ambition.” What is the likely subtext?
prompt.ar: ما المعنى الضمني الأرجح لهذه العبارة؟

options: The book succeeds on every level.
The author showed no real ambition.
The reviewer never read the book.

explanation.en: Praising only the intention is a standard way of withholding praise for the result.
explanation.ar: مدح النية وحدها أسلوب معروف لحجب المدح عن النتيجة.

options: Were it not for her, the project would have failed.
If it were not for her, the project will have failed.
Was it not for her, the project would have failed.
Had it not for her, the project would have failed.

explanation.en: Formal inversion of “if it were not for” drops “if” and fronts “were”.
explanation.ar: القلب الرسمي لـ if it were not for يحذف if ويقدّم were.
